# Reference

Precise, look-it-up documentation. Most of this section is **generated** — do not edit
the generated files by hand; run the generator and commit the result.

## Generated by `make docs` (`scripts/gen-docs.py`)

- **[Tools](tools.md)** — the toolsets JARVIS exposes to the agent (built-in + plugin).
- **[Plugins](plugins.md)** — the in-repo Hermes plugins, their tools, commands and hooks.
- **[Skills](skills.md)** — the curated skills the deployed agent can load, and when each applies.
- **[MCP servers](mcp-servers.md)** — the Model Context Protocol servers Hermes launches.
- **[Slash commands](slash-commands.md)** — plugin and gateway commands.
- **[API endpoints](api-endpoints.md)** — the adapter and console HTTP surfaces.
- **[HUD protocol](hud-protocol.md)** — index into the contract doc.
- **[Approval matrix](approval-matrix.md)** — what JARVIS may do freely, must ask about, or may never do for a guest.
- **[Paired-device access](paired-access.md)** — the WebSocket commands, REST routes and event types a paired device's token may reach, each with the client that needs it.
